svg.title: Skills
svg.desc: Strong means production use on my own, working means I've shipped something real with it, and familiar means coursework or tutorials. I don't round up. Strong: ServiceNow, Active Directory / Tanium. Working: Python, RAG, Large language models, Agentic AI, Scikit-learn, Pandas / NumPy, SQL, JavaScript / TypeScript, Git, Salesforce CRM. Familiar: NLP, PyTorch / TensorFlow, Docker, AWS, C++.
